title: Milwaukee Brewers win the World Series in five games
dek: The Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 for the first championship in the club's history.
what: NBC Sports and MLB.com report that the Milwaukee Brewers beat the Tampa Bay Rays 4-1 in Game 5 on Wednesday night, 28 October 2026, to win the World Series four games to one. It is the first World Series title in the club's history.

NBC Sports reports that catcher William Contreras was named World Series MVP, that starter Jacob Misiorowski pitched 5 and two-thirds scoreless innings, and that rookie shortstop Cooper Pratt drove in two runs. Yahoo Sports and others describe Game 4 as a walk-off win for the Rays.
MLB's account on X posted a photo declaring the Brewers champions, and the Brewers' own account posted a photo saying the title belongs to Milwaukee, Wisconsin. Both match the reporting.
why: A small-market club won its first title, and the posts around it are mostly from fans of Milwaukee and of the sport marking the end of a long wait.
